sources.title: Compile and cache ONNX models in Windows ML | Microsoft Learn
sources.snippet: The Windows ML walkthrough demonstrates the basic compile-on-first-run mechanics by checking whether a compiled artifact exists. It isn't a complete cache-management example. Before you reuse an existing compiled model in an app, apply the compatibility check described in this article. For the compilation API in context, see Compile models.

sources.title: Accelerate model loading on Amazon EKS - Amazon EKS
sources.snippet: Reduce model loading and compilation time for inference workloads on Amazon EKS by tuning Run:ai Model Streamer concurrency and caching torch.compile artifacts for large models.
